purpose: Freeze a layered, non-top1, partially observable 1..12 research target vocabulary for comparing rule-based and learned stage assessments without promoting any historical Stage proposition or changing Continuous Facts authority.

0_DIRECTIONLESS.meaning: Valid PIT evidence supports directionless price action.

ABSTAIN.meaning: Usable inputs do not support a sufficiently definite assertion.

X.meaning: Ordinary stage inference is invalid or frozen because of data or market-condition controls.

severe_error_defaults.paired_metric_case_rule: within the fixed reference slice, severe-error rate comparison uses identical cases with finite calibrated probabilities from both candidate and comparator; missing prediction is not imputed and is governed by the frozen coverage/inconclusive rules

cards.semantic_intent: T-only deceleration or stabilization nested inside a qualified downside context; it does not itself assert structural repair.
t_visible_evidence_requirements: qualified Stage12 downside context at T
T-only downside momentum deceleration or selling-pressure exhaustion evidence
no future recovery or later support reclaim

positive: Qualified downside context with materially decelerating decline and T-only stabilization evidence, while repair remains unproven.
negative: Qualified downside context with decline continuing or accelerating and no T-only stabilization evidence.
ambiguous: Downside velocity decelerates but structure/order and selling-pressure evidence materially conflict.
unjudgeable: Stage12 parent context or required T-only downside/stabilization facts are unavailable.

negative: T-only facts show directional disorder, expansion, or unstable center incompatible with orderly consolidation.
ambiguous: Width and center/order channels point in conflicting directions.
unjudgeable: Required T-only Structure Order or geometry facts are missing or reset.

claim_ceiling: This target set freezes semantics only. It does not claim any head is trainable, calibrated, reference-qualified, predictive, economically useful, official, production-ready, or authorized for strategy/trading use.

fields.applicability: true when the frozen target population is satisfied; false when parent/context is known not applicable; null when required parent/context is unavailable or unknown
fields.raw_score: nullable [0,1] learned support score; not a probability
fields.calibrated_probability: nullable probability only after the per-head calibration gate

raw_score_coverage.numerator: reference_eligible definite cases with target applicability true and finite confirmatory primary raw score from all required seeds
raw_score_coverage.denominator: reference_eligible definite cases with target applicability true

calibrated_probability_coverage.numerator: reference_eligible definite applicable cases with publishable calibrated_probability
calibrated_probability_coverage.denominator: reference_eligible definite cases with target applicability true

assertion_coverage.numerator: reference_eligible definite applicable cases with ASSERT_POSITIVE or ASSERT_NEGATIVE
assertion_coverage.denominator: reference_eligible definite cases with target applicability true

base_membership.data_scope: exact B-bound 2012-01-01..2021-12-31 SSE/SZSE development manifest only
base_membership.control_requirement: ordinary inference control state ACTIVE; X is outside the Stage-assessment population
base_membership.semantic_applicability: every base member is applicable for marginal-head semantics; missing target-specific T-only facts make that head UNAVAILABLE, not NOT_APPLICABLE
prohibited_membership_inputs: post-T correction not known at T
current sector membership used as historical proxy

sampling_roles.train: label-aware enrichment may be separately preregistered by B for training efficiency, but must preserve source inclusion probabilities/role and cannot define calibration/evaluation prevalence
sampling_roles.development_validation: outcome-blind sample from the frozen base population; selection rule frozen by B before label adjudication
sampling_roles.calibration: outcome-blind sample from the frozen base population; no positive/negative enrichment
sampling_roles.evaluation: outcome-blind sample from the frozen base population; no positive/negative enrichment; confirmatory probability claims refer only to this frozen population/sample design
